caption: The drawing depicts a decorative, hexagonal container with a domed lid that has a knob-like finial at the top center. The container appears to be made of metal, with a brownish base color and greenish areas suggesting patina or oxidation. It features vertical ridges at its corners and beveled edges, giving it a structured, architectural appearance. There is a small, projecting, covered compartment on one visible side. The surface of the object combines shades of brown, green, and some yellow highlights, creating a mottled, aged look. The background is plain and uncolored, focusing attention solely on the object. The artist's signature, "Chas F. Moss 38," is visible in red in the lower left corner.
title: Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
